integrity: All numerical checks use integer arithmetic; a standalone script enumerates graph-defined minimal dominating sets independently of the formula. The infinite claim rests on the supplied case proof.
scientific_limitations: Only complete bipartite graphs with two shores of size at least two; no exact inverse kernel or general-graph assertion. Earlier unindexed signed enumerator specializations could affect priority.
title: A mod-four collision law for Walsh nullity of minimal dominating sets on \(K_{a,b}\)
